description: Run an x402 Forge tool on your own input and get its answer ({ok, result, warnings}) plus a signed receipt. Paid per call with x402 inside this MCP call: without a payment the result is the payment terms (x402Version, accepts: the tool's own price in USDC, network and payee, the same as GET /p/{slug}); an x402 MCP client signs one and calls again with it in _meta["x402/payment"]. Never charged for an error: an unknown or sold tool and invalid input are refused before any price, and a failed run is not settled. Free first: try_product runs the example; describe_product shows the input schema.

input.description: The tool's parameters as one JSON object (describe_product shows its input schema)

name: call_tool
title: Call a tool (paid per call via x402)
